@@ -812,6 +812,19 @@ Gate health is sampled every tick and rolled up per gate.

+### Weekly escape digest
+
+`escape.digest.build_digest` buckets `EscapeRecord` rows by ISO week (UTC) and
+is rendered on the Insights tab via `GET /api/insights/escape-digest`. Upheld
+sampled-audit disagreements reach the ledger with
+`detection_source: sampled-audit`; refuted ones never do, so the digest counts
+escapes and not auditor false alarms.
+
diff --git a/src/escape/digest.py b/src/escape/digest.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..6d41b0f
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/escape/digest.py
@@ -0,0 +1,64 @@
+"""Weekly aggregation of escape-ledger records (#9812)."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import logging
+from collections import Counter, defaultdict
+from collections.abc import Iterable
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from datetime import datetime
+
+from escape.models import EscapeRecord
+
+logger = logging.getLogger("hydraflow.escape.digest")
+
+MIN_WEEKS = 1
+MAX_WEEKS = 26
+UNKNOWN_BUCKET = "unknown"
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class WeekBucket:
+    """One ISO-week row of the digest. ``iso_week`` is ``YYYY-Www`` or ``unknown``."""
+
+    iso_week: str
+    total: int
+    by_source: dict[str, int]
+    by_stratum: dict[str, int]
+    top_prs: tuple[int, ...]
+
+
+def _week_key(record: EscapeRecord) -> str:
+    try:
+        stamp = datetime.fromisoformat(record.detected_at)
+    except ValueError:
+        return UNKNOWN_BUCKET
+    year, week, _ = stamp.isocalendar()
+    return f"{year}-W{week:02d}"
+
+
+def build_digest(
+    records: Iterable[EscapeRecord], *, weeks: int = 8
+) -> list[WeekBucket]:
+    """Bucket ``records`` by ISO week, newest first, at most ``weeks`` buckets."""
+    grouped: dict[str, list[EscapeRecord]] = defaultdict(list)
+    unparseable = 0
+    for record in records:
+        key = _week_key(record)
+        if key == UNKNOWN_BUCKET:
+            unparseable += 1
+        grouped[key].append(record)
+    if unparseable:
+        logger.warning("escape digest: %d record(s) with unparseable detected_at", unparseable)
+
+    ordered = sorted(grouped, reverse=True)[:weeks]
+    buckets: list[WeekBucket] = []
+    for key in ordered:
+        rows = grouped[key]
+        buckets.append(
+            WeekBucket(
+                iso_week=key,
+                total=len(rows),
+                by_source=dict(Counter(r.detection_source for r in rows)),
+                by_stratum=dict(Counter(r.blast_radius for r in rows)),
+                top_prs=tuple(r.pr_number for r in rows[:3]),
+            )
+        )
+    return buckets

--- a/src/static/js/insights.js
+++ b/src/static/js/insights.js
@@ -142,6 +142,29 @@ async function renderGateHealth() {
   host.replaceChildren(table);
 }

+async function renderEscapeDigest() {
+  const host = document.querySelector("#escape-digest");
+  const res = await fetch("/api/insights/escape-digest?weeks=8");
+  const data = await res.json();
+  if (!data.buckets.length) {
+    host.textContent = "No escapes recorded in the last 8 weeks.";
+    return;
+  }
+  const cell = (text) => {
+    const td = document.createElement("td");
+    td.textContent = text;
+    return td;
+  };
+  const rows = data.buckets.map((b) => {
+    const tr = document.createElement("tr");
+    tr.append(
+      cell(b.iso_week),
+      cell(String(b.total)),
+      cell(Object.entries(b.by_source).map(([k, v]) => k + ":" + v).join(", ")),
+      cell(b.top_prs.join(", ")),
+    );
+    return tr;
+  });
+  const table = document.createElement("table");
+  table.append(...rows);
+  host.replaceChildren(table, sparkline(data.buckets.map((b) => b.total)));
+}
+

             handle.write(json.dumps(record.to_row()) + "\n")

+    def read_all(self) -> list[EscapeRecord]:
+        """Every ledger row, oldest first. Missing file reads as empty."""
+        if not self._path.exists():
+            return []
+        rows = []
+        for line in self._path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines():
+            if line.strip():
+                rows.append(EscapeRecord.from_row(json.loads(line)))
+        return rows
+
diff --git a/tests/test_escape_digest.py b/tests/test_escape_digest.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..2ab4e19
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/test_escape_digest.py
@@ -0,0 +1,34 @@
+from escape.digest import build_digest
+from escape.models import EscapeRecord
+
+
+def _rec(pr, when, source="sampled-audit", stratum="routine"):
+    return EscapeRecord(
+        pr_number=pr, detected_at=when, detection_source=source, blast_radius=stratum
+    )
+
+
+def test_build_digest_is_empty_for_no_records():
+    assert build_digest([]) == []
+
+
+def test_build_digest_groups_two_records_in_one_week():
+    buckets = build_digest(
+        [_rec(1, "2026-07-20T10:00:00+00:00"), _rec(2, "2026-07-22T10:00:00+00:00")]
+    )
+    assert len(buckets) == 1
+    assert buckets[0].total == 2
+    assert buckets[0].by_source == {"sampled-audit": 2}
+
+
+def test_build_digest_orders_weeks_newest_first():
+    buckets = build_digest(
+        [_rec(1, "2026-07-06T10:00:00+00:00"), _rec(2, "2026-07-20T10:00:00+00:00")]
+    )
+    assert [b.iso_week for b in buckets] == ["2026-W30", "2026-W28"]
+
+
+def test_build_digest_buckets_unparseable_timestamp_as_unknown():
+    buckets = build_digest([_rec(1, "not-a-timestamp")])
+    assert [b.iso_week for b in buckets] == ["unknown"]
